platform_rule: Use Data-to-Decision Assurance to strengthen existing Platform A modules without introducing additional standalone data governance products.
platform_position: Azure provides enterprise data engineering capabilities. COBIT-Chain evaluates whether the complete enterprise data lifecycle is operationally trustworthy before AI-assisted decisions are made.
engineering_principle: Trusted Data -> Trusted Context -> Trusted AI Recommendation -> Trusted Human Decision -> Trusted Evidence.

lifecycle.engineering_question: Are source systems trusted, owned, current, and appropriate for the AI-assisted decision?
lifecycle.assurance_role: Validate source ownership, source classification, source trust, data freshness, regulated relevance, and permitted use.

lifecycle.engineering_question: Can ingestion be trusted, monitored, and replayed?
lifecycle.assurance_role: Evaluate ingestion ownership, source-to-target mapping, validation, error handling, run logs, and exception routing.

lifecycle.engineering_question: Can streaming data be trusted at the time of decision?
lifecycle.assurance_role: Validate event source, stream freshness, latency, ordering, loss detection, replay capability, and operational monitoring.

lifecycle.engineering_question: Is stored data secure, governed, versioned, and retained within approved boundaries?
lifecycle.assurance_role: Validate storage boundary, access policy, retention, encryption, backup, versioning, and evidence retention.

lifecycle.engineering_question: Can transformed data be traced to source data and transformation logic?
lifecycle.assurance_role: Evaluate transformation ownership, transformation logic, code version, mapping rules, change control, and validation evidence.

lifecycle.engineering_question: Is data quality sufficient for the intended AI-assisted decision?
lifecycle.assurance_role: Assess completeness, accuracy, consistency, timeliness, duplicates, outliers, quality thresholds, and exception handling.

lifecycle.engineering_question: Can decision data be traced from source to AI recommendation?
lifecycle.assurance_role: Bind source, ingestion, storage, transformation, quality, serving, AI context, recommendation, and decision evidence into one lineage path.

lifecycle.engineering_question: Can data served to the AI system be trusted at the point of use?
lifecycle.assurance_role: Validate API, feature store, semantic layer, retrieval index, access boundary, freshness, and response traceability.

lifecycle.engineering_question: Is the AI context grounded in trusted data and valid for the workflow?
lifecycle.assurance_role: Validate context assembly, retrieval grounding, prompt context, source trust, workflow owner, and permitted use.

lifecycle.engineering_question: Did a named human review the AI recommendation before the decision was made?
lifecycle.assurance_role: Confirm reviewer identity, review checklist, approval decision, exception rationale, accountability, and decision boundary.

lifecycle.engineering_question: Can the human decision be replayed with trusted data, trusted context, AI recommendation, review, and evidence?
lifecycle.assurance_role: Bind the full data-to-decision chain into an evidence package that supports operational trust and inspection readiness.
